geometry: Reserve full pool, trigger anchor, settlement/dock, explicit details trigger and every current visible input/control rectangle.
Each obstacle split prunes undersized candidates, deduplicates equal rectangles and removes contained rectangles; future cuts cannot increase usable dimensions.
Actual placement.height is the CSS maximum height. No usable rectangle falls back to visible details button/F2/menu.

Repeated identical or pool-contained obstacles no longer expand the candidate set. The containment pass is quadratic in the remaining candidate count; no linear-time guarantee is claimed for arbitrary distinct layouts. The 10,000-rectangle unit case is synthetic geometry, not 10,000 rendered controls.
transit: Four directional trapezoids connect original anchor to actual panel; finite coordinates and strictly separated edges avoid division by zero.
Only original anchor pointerout initiates travelling. Intermediate pointerover holds the original item only while that journey is active.
Leaving the corridor resumes the usual delayed hover even while still inside the same intermediate card. Pure keyboard focus does not capture unrelated direct mouse entry.
Pointerdown and actual material selection remain unmodified; tooltip reading permits internal scrolling/text selection.
lifecycleAndTransactions: Dismissal clears show/hide timers and aria-describedby, and suppresses same-trigger resurrection until real exit/re-entry.
Saved-state reference and target signature keep UI-only undo expiry refresh readable; true state/target changes close stale details.
Modal close/Escape restores connected inspected-card focus with a visible details-button fallback.
Explicit two-control Tab loop prevents the observed Ctrl+A/native Tab escape; modal keyboard routing blocks material shortcuts while retaining native reading keys.
Touch pointerdown/up applies an 800ms compatibility-mouseover cooldown; real keyboard input restores keyboard interaction immediately.
Added data is ephemeral controller/UI state; app.act, confirmation, full expected snapshots, Web Locks and storage remain untouched.
